summary: Baker County, OR cab site in the Wallowa-Whitman NF: registers date an L-4 cab to 1936 and its abandonment to 1947, but a 1958 newspaper shows it staffed. Now gone.

facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com list the cab as gone; no source describes what remains at the site today
facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Wallowa-Whitman National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com give 1947 as the abandonment date, but a July 24, 1958 Baker Record-Courier item, quoted on Forest Lookouts, shows the lookout staffed that summer. Not resolved: either the 1947 date is wrong or the cab was used again.
firelookout.com says the site may not have actually been used and refers readers to its Bald Mtn. entry. Not resolved.

notes_for_editor: Record conflicts: 1947 abandonment (register, firelookout.com) vs the July 1958 staffing item (Forest Lookouts). Second entry to check: firelookout.com also lists 'Bald (Dooley) Mountain', ground, gone, FFLOS US 1104, OR 460, at 44.57412, -117.89368; our record is 44.58244, -117.83097 (about 5 km apart). Could be a duplicate or a separate site; not resolved. The Baker Air Force Station radar site (Beaver Mountain, 1959-1968) came up in a search snippet but was not read, so it is not in the story. Access: no source read; left out.
